title: Project with an established design system
prompt: Add an analytics page to our app. We use our internal design system (tokens in src/styles/tokens.css, components in src/components/ui). Follow it strictly; don't invent new styles.

must: Reads the existing tokens and component inventory before designing
New page composed from existing components; zero off-token values
Genuine gaps in the system extended through its own conventions, flagged as proposals
System coherence scored against THEIR system, not the plugin's directions library
Detector run confirms no off-token colors (system/off-token-colors clean)
must_not: A parallel styling layer or new palette
Replacing their components with 'better' ones uninvited
